verdict.rationale: Shortwave ships a built-in AI Assistant that can read threads, write drafts, search the full email history, and check your calendar. Through AI Integrations and MCP it can also run complex workflows across Slack, Notion, Asana, GitHub, Zapier and more, and triggers let it draft replies automatically when emails arrive. A third-party security write-up independently confirms the AI Email/MCP agent capability, but missing for 10: hands-on user reports of delegating multi-step tasks to the assistant and seeing it complete them reliably.
